tagline: Leading freight rail transportation connecting North America's commerce
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting the railroad carrier's operational efficiency, with a 32.1% margin that remains solid despite a 400 basis point contraction due to labor cost increases and higher service fees

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from freight transportation services
kpis.description: Total revenue from all business segments including merchandise, intermodal, coal, and trucking services
kpis.signal: Revenue decline driven by lower coal export volumes, merchandise volume reductions, and lower fuel recovery, partially offset by merchandise pricing gains and higher intermodal volume

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue
kpis.description: Operating income divided by total revenue, demonstrating the company's operational efficiency
kpis.signal: Operating margin compression from 36.1% to 32.1% due to labor cost inflation (+$67M), higher separation costs (+$51M), and goodwill impairment charges

kpis.name: Intermodal Volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of intermodal container and trailer shipments
kpis.description: Number of intermodal containers and trailers transported, measured in thousands of units
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by higher port volumes and international shipments, plus domestic customer wins despite soft trucking market conditions

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of $14.09B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Net income of $2.89B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $43.68B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $19.35B in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of $0.67B in the latest year

kpis.name: Coal Volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of coal shipments transported by rail
kpis.description: Coal volume measured in thousands of units, combining both export and domestic coal transportation
kpis.signal: Modest decline driven by lower export volumes due to customer facility outages and lower metallurgical/thermal coal demand, partially offset by higher domestic utility shipments

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict railroad industry regulations by the FRA, STB, and other government agencies, which may impact its operational flexibility and costs.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where alternative modes of transportation, such as trucking, represent a direct threat to volumes and pricing.

risks.title: Natural Hazards
risks.score_rationale: Natural events such as severe storms, flooding, wildfires, hurricanes, and earthquakes can disrupt operations and damage the company's extensive railroad infrastructure.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on critical information systems for railroad operations and is exposed to cyberattack risks that could affect operational safety and continuity.

risks.title: Economic Demand Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on demand for its freight transportation services, which fluctuates based on domestic and international economic conditions, including trade agreements.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial risks including capital access, interest rates, and debt management to finance operations and infrastructure investments.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks affecting international trade, tariffs, and commercial relationships that impact freight volumes transported.

risks.title: Human Resources Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on its skilled workforce for railroad operations and faces challenges in talent retention and attraction in a tight labor market.
